title: Погром в баре  (Chaos at the Bar)

segments.t: At the Claude Monet bar, Kostya is horrified to find shattered glass everywhere and six bottles of elite cognac missing or broken while Ainura mops the floor. Listen to the whole exchange first, and then we will break it down line by line.
У тебя неудачное шоу в баре?
Забыли закрыть, и ночью кто-то забрался.
Now let's go back through their conversation line by line and unpack the Russian phrasing.

'Kostya, what happened here?' Over the chaos and the plan, Max presses Ainura for a straight answer. In Russian, he does not need helper words like "do" or "did"—rising pitch alone turns it into a question.
У тебя неудачное шоу в баре?
'Did you have a bad bartender show?' Here asking whether Ainura has a bad bartender show shows Max looking for the real truth.
'I will find out who was juggling here at night.' Mentioning that he will find out who was juggling here at night moves the talk in a new direction.

'Ainura, could you clean up faster?' Asking whether Ainura cleans up faster cuts straight through the tension between Kostya and Ainura. Russian packs the whole idea of what is allowed or needed into one impersonal word at the front.
'Listen, Kostya, do not bother me.' Because do not bother, Ainura treats the matter as settled.
'Let me breathe in the expensive cognac a bit.' Even though Kostya should let her breathe in the expensive cognac a bit, Ainura keeps a steady face in front of Kostya.
'They smashed three bottles last night.' With the work and chaos in play, Kostya keeps this short reply brisk and direct.
'Maybe only two bottles?' Over the shift and the chaos, Max presses Ainura for a straight answer.
'No, not two, three.' Over the work and the chaos, Kostya answers Ainura without a second thought.
Забыли закрыть, и ночью кто-то забрался.
'They forgot to lock up, and someone broke in at night.' Kostya explains that they forgot to lock up and someone broke in at night, keeping his voice calm and direct.
'Who could have done that?' By wondering who have done could, Max presses Ainura for a straight answer.
'Well of course, not me.' With the point and chaos in play, Kostya keeps this short reply brisk and direct.

'And what are you doing here?' Over the moment and the chaos, Ainura presses Kostya for a straight answer. Notice how she sticks to the formal "you", keeping a professional line between them. Alright, let's hear the entire conversation one more time from start to finish.
У тебя неудачное шоу в баре?
Забыли закрыть, и ночью кто-то забрался.
Max suddenly realizes why there were two extra bottles in Katya's apartment. Next, Chef Barinov walks in with a massive hangover of his own. Until next time!
